groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle J1 with its CC1/CC2 5k1 pull-downs (R6, R4), the 0R shell-to-GND link R5, the D+/D- ESD diodes D8/D5 and the VBUS ESD diode D7 on the connector side of the B5819W input Schottky D6 (J1 VBUS -> board VBUS)

groups.name: power
groups.why: the +5V/+3V3 power path: B5819W D4 (VBUS -> +5V) and the DMG3415U P-FET Q1 (gate on VBUS, R15 100k pulling VBUS down when unplugged) that feeds +5V from +BATT; the SY8088 buck U5 (+5V -> +3V3) with its input cap C5, inductor L1, output cap C7, feedback divider R2/R3 with feed-forward C6, and EN pull-up R1; D1, the LESD8D3.3 TVS on the +3V3 rail

templates.why: SY8088 1.5 MHz synchronous buck (+5V -> +3V3), LX on pin 3 drives L1; Silergy AN_SY8088 layout guidelines (text, no figure)

groups.name: charger
groups.why: MCP73831 Li-ion charger U6 (VBUS -> +BATT) with its VDD input cap C15, VBAT output cap C16, PROG resistor R9, and the charge-status LED D3 with its 1k resistor R14 on STAT

groups.name: core
groups.why: the ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module U3 with its +3V3 decaps (C1/C2/C11 10nF, C3/C4/C9 100nF, C8 1uF), the 32.768 kHz crystal Y1 on GPIO0/GPIO1 with its DNP load caps C12/C13 and DNP bridge R12

groups.name: buttons
groups.why: reset button SW1 on CHIP_PU with its RC (R8 10k pull-up, C10 1uF), and boot button SW2 on IO9 with its pull-up R19 and 1nF C14; the RC goes with its button (placement-lessons: reset RC beside the reset button)

groups.name: sensors
groups.why: the I2C sensors on IO8_SCL/IO10_SDA: SHTC3 U1 (temperature/humidity) and ICM-42670-P IMU U2 with its 0R CS tie R7 and its INT2 test point TP2 (on the back), plus the bus's 10k pull-ups R17/R18; kept apart from the power group because the SHTC3 measures ambient temperature and the buck/charger dissipate heat (run judgment)

groups.name: leds
groups.why: the WS2812B RGB LED D9 with its 0R data link R11 from IO2, and the IO7 indicator LED D2 with its 470R resistor R10
